evals.name: constructed-60-kitchen
evals.prompt: Build me one 60-card kitchen-table deck from my collection export at evals/files/collection.csv. Casual power level, no restrictions beyond only using cards I own (basic lands are fine to add). I want a Moxfield-importable decklist saved as a .txt file, and a single self-contained HTML report explaining the build decisions, the playtesting you did, and the deck's strengths and weaknesses.
evals.expected_output: A 60-card deck using only owned cards + basics, a timestamped Moxfield-format .txt, and one self-contained HTML report with decisions, playtest statistics and matchup analysis.
expectations: A decklist .txt exists and every non-blank line parses as Moxfield format ('N Card Name' or 'N Card Name (SET) number')
The main deck contains exactly 60 cards
Every nonbasic card is in the collection CSV and its count does not exceed the owned count
No nonbasic card exceeds 4 copies (kitchen-table copy limit)
An HTML report exists and loads no external http(s) scripts/styles/images (renders offline)
The report contains build-decision, mana-curve, playtest-statistics, sample-game, and strengths/weaknesses sections
The report includes quantitative playtest numbers (keepable-hand or mulligan percentage)

evals.name: league-40x2-simultaneous
evals.prompt: From my collection export at evals/files/collection.csv, build TWO 40-card sealed-league decks (17 lands each) using ONLY cards from the Lorwyn Eclipsed set (set code ECL), plus any basic lands. Both decks must be buildable at the same time: across the two decks, no card may be used more times than I own it. Make them genuinely different strategies. Deliver a Moxfield-importable .txt decklist for each deck and ONE self-contained HTML report covering both decks with playtest results and a ranked comparison.
evals.expected_output: Two distinct 40-card ECL-only decks with zero over-usage across both (simultaneous policy), two timestamped Moxfield .txt files, one self-contained HTML report with playtests and ranking.
expectations: Two decklist .txt files exist and every non-blank line parses as Moxfield format
Each main deck contains exactly 40 cards
Every nonbasic card is owned in set ECL according to the collection CSV printings
Across both decks combined, no nonbasic card is used more times than owned (simultaneous overlap policy)
Exactly one HTML report exists and loads no external http(s) scripts/styles/images (renders offline)
The report contains playtest statistics for both decks and a ranked comparison section
